validity_findings.finding: The initial EXECUTE analysis constructed NC_LIVE_HTTPBIN_UUID same-session cookie maps as {'_': <uuid_value>}, causing R_SESSION_BIND to fire vacuously on all 8/8 live-null fields. This was a control-construction bug, not a rule-family defect. The producer corrected the cookie-map to the faithful empty map (httpbin.org/uuid sets no cookies), re-ran the analysis, and preserved the pre-correction artifact verbatim at derived/controls_initial_live_null_selfbind_bug.json. The correction changed only the null/liveness gate; the confirmatory primary metric and all frozen rules/thresholds were untouched. This is properly disclosed in validity_notes V1 and observation O11.

The DESIGN-embedded literal irreducibility null reported 1/1600 fields fired (aggregate FP 0.000625, rule R_WALLCLOCK_B64); the EXECUTE frozen-seed re-run reported 0/1600 (aggregate FP 0.0). Both satisfy the frozen NULL_FP_MAX=0.05 requirement. The discrepancy is disclosed and the DESIGN literal is carried alongside the EXECUTE re-run. This limits the EXECUTE-only bound on R_WALLCLOCK_B64's real false-positive rate but does not alter any branch outcome.

PC_PLANTED_CLASSES is authored by the instrument designer and certifies the detector code path and sensitivity, NOT the construct boundary on the real Web. This is explicitly disclosed as a residual validity threat in validity_notes V4 and controls[PC_PLANTED_CLASSES].construct_boundary. Mitigations are the out-of-author NC_LIVE_HTTPBIN_UUID live null (passed) and the fresh real-Web confirmatory collection.

The frozen 57-endpoint universe is a curated convenience pool spanning Rails/GitLab, Gitea, Discourse, MediaWiki, Django, forum and login/search endpoints. All rates describe this pool in one collection window (one stdlib-HTTP client, one User-Agent, one network vantage). It is not a probability sample of the Web. This is a scope boundary, properly disclosed in validity_notes V5 and scope_boundaries.

Only credential-free HTTP GET-observable fields are measured. No JavaScript/DOM/SPA-rendered, authenticated, WebSocket/GraphQL, edge or mobile-sourced token is observable. Response bodies are not archived (only body_sha256 per observation), so body-level re-derivation is not reconstructable from this packet. The NONCE stratum contains exactly 1 admitted field (a csp-nonce), so its separate estimate is not informative. This is properly disclosed in validity_notes V6.

In this collection window, several frozen endpoints were Cloudflare-blocked (403) or rate-limited (429), including three endpoints admitted in the DESIGN census (gitlab.archlinux.org, salsa.debian.org, gitlab.freedesktop.org). Overall admission (46 indicator fields, 27 sites) still far exceeds the frozen minima (M_MIN_FIELDS=20, S_MIN_SITES=8), so no measurement-invalid condition fires. However, per-site coverage is window-dependent and the census monotonicity argument is not strictly reproduced endpoint-by-endpoint. Disclosed in validity_notes V8 and observation O10.

11 armed rules raise per-field false-positive risk; the frozen 1600-field calibration bounds aggregate FP (<= 0.05) and counted fields must additionally beat B_MEMORY_REPEAT by DELTA_MEM=0.10. Class attribution follows the frozen priority and can mislabel when several rules fire (e.g., R_B62_INCR also fires on digit strings); this affects only the class breakdown (PREDICTABLE_PREVALENCE_BY_CLASS), not the pooled PREDICTABLE_PREVALENCE_POOLED indicator. Disclosed in validity_notes V7.

Wallclock rules (R_WALLCLOCK_DEC/HEX/B64) compare candidate substrings against the CLIENT-side collection wall-clock epoch (time.time() at request time), not a server clock. Any server/client clock skew or timezone-independent epoch offset within +/-3600 s is absorbed by the 1-hour tolerance. This is a deliberate frozen design choice, disclosed in validity_notes V3. The pypi.org R_WALLCLOCK_B64 detection (12 s delta) is well within tolerance.

baseline_findings.finding: B_MEMORY_REPEAT mean holdout accuracy = 0.336, driven by identity-persistent session cookies (e.g., _gitlab_session, authSession, *_Session, flarum_session) that repeat the same value for 3 requests within a session then rotate. The two counted predictable fields exceed this baseline by >= DELTA_MEM=0.10: pypi.org session_id (1.0 - 0.714 = 0.286), reddit.com jsc_token (1.0 - 0.0 = 1.0). The baseline correctly disqualifies memory-repeat-explained fields and does not gate the two genuine structural predictabilities.

B_MARKOV1 mean holdout accuracy = 0.059, substantially below B_MEMORY_REPEAT (0.336) because the varying fields (CSRF/one-time tokens, discourse-track-view-session-id) show no first-order recurrence structure. This is reported as a sensitivity check only, not a disqualifier, consistent with the mandate that predictability classes explicitly include non-trivial transforms of the previous value.
B_CONSTANT_MODE mean accuracy = 0.0, as expected since admission excludes constant fields (n_distinct >= 2). Serves as a triviality anchor so no prevalence claim is an unanchored absolute.

B_IRREDUCIBILITY_NULL (NC_PLANTED_RANDOM) EXECUTE re-run: 0/1600 fields fired, aggregate FP = 0.0, all 11 non-baseline rules ARMED. This replicates the DESIGN calibration (1/1600 fired, FP = 0.000625) within tolerance. Both satisfy the frozen NULL_FP_MAX=0.05 gate. The null has demonstrated discriminating power: the same rule family detects all 8 planted positive-control classes at power 1.0 while firing on essentially no cryptographic null fields.

PC_PLANTED_CLASSES EXECUTE re-run: all 8 classes detected at power 1.0 (200/200 trials each), exceeding the frozen PC_POWER_MIN=0.8 requirement. This certifies the detector code path and sensitivity for the frozen rule family.

NC_LIVE_HTTPBIN_UUID (out-of-author live null): 8 fields collected across 8 fresh sessions, 0/8 fields fired (fired fraction 0.0), satisfying the <= 0.05 gate. The cookie-map construction was corrected to the faithful empty map (httpbin sets no cookies); the pre-correction artifact is preserved.

claim_ceiling: The FALSIFIES outcome is correctly derived from the frozen branch precedence (S0): PREDICTABLE_PREVALENCE_POOLED = 0.0435 <= P_FLOOR = 0.10 AND site-clustered 95% CI upper bound = 0.116 < P_HI = 0.25. Per the frozen claim_ceiling, this FALSIFIES outcome is bounded to the frozen credential-free action-gating substrate class and window; it does not close C-WEB-DYNAMICS or the Physics domain and authorizes no Product promotion. The negative is valid and decision-changing: it establishes that on this substrate, server-minted action-gating state is observation-bound and the architecture must persist procedures/paths and re-observe values fresh.

unresolved.question: Do the two counted predictable classes (pypi.org itsdangerous-style timestamp segment; reddit.com jsc_token constant 32-hex prefix) persist across collection windows, or are they point-in-time artifacts that may be rotated by the operator?
What is the real-Web predictability prevalence on JavaScript-rendered, authenticated, or SPA substrates that this credential-free HTTP GET instrument cannot observe?

Why did R_WALLCLOCK_B64 fire once in the DESIGN literal null battery and zero times in the EXECUTE re-run with the same nominal seeds? This is a within-tolerance discrepancy but limits the EXECUTE-only bound on that rule's false-positive rate.
What produces the constant 32-hex-character prefix of reddit.com jsc_token and does it carry predictive information about the random suffix?

Whether the architecture should persist procedures/paths and re-observe values fresh is informed but not decided by this bounded negative; a product-level cost comparison is out of scope for this physics packet.
